The surname '''Lewin''' can refer to the following people:

*[[Lewin]] - a [[Jenn Aiel]] who lived during the [[Breaking of the World]].
*[[Adine Lewin]] - a woman from the [[Two Rivers]], wife of Flann and aunt of Dannil and Tell.
*[[Dannil Lewin]] - a man from the Two Rivers, cousin of Tell and nephew of Adine and Flann.
*[[Emry Lewin]] - a young woman from [[Emond's Field]] and a [[Novice]] in the [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Tower in exile]].
*[[Flann Lewin]] - a farmer from the Two Rivers, husband of Adine and uncle of Dannil and Tell.
*[[Jillie Lewin]] - a young woman from Emond's Field.
*[[Laila Lewin]] - formerly a Dearn, now married to Natley.
*[[Laila Lewin's infant]] - child of [[Laila Lewin]] and [[Natley Lewin]].
*[[Maddy Lewin]] - a young woman from the Two Rivers.
*[[Natley Lewin]] - a man from the Two Rivers and husband of Laila.
*[[Tell Lewin]] - a man from the Two Rivers, cousin of Dannil and nephew of Adine and Flann.
*[[Win Lewin]] - a boy from the Two Rivers.
